description: Use when an agent must confirm a wallet holds enough of a token before it swaps, pays or settles: the ERC-20 balance of any address for any token (USDC, USDT, DAI or any other), returned raw (exact integer string) with its decimals, the formatted amount and the symbol, so no rounding is forced on you. Do not use for the native coin (/v1/evm/balance) or for what a contract is allowed to spend (/v1/evm/erc20-allowance). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).
name: evm_erc20_balance
title: ERC20 token balance
